accessibility: The pill is a toolbar named Canvas tools with a roving tab stop: arrows, Home and End move between the tools; the tool in effect is aria-pressed.
An unavailable tool is aria-disabled, not disabled, so it keeps focus and hover and its reason is the tooltip and its accessible description; it is never carried by color alone.
Tools carry their single-key shortcuts (V, C, I) as aria-keyshortcuts unless single-key shortcuts are turned off; touch tiers hide the hints and use 44px targets.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (CanvasStage, SegmentedControl, Segment, Stack, Text, Kbd); no Widget outside the Adapter catalog.

The pill is the CanvasStage palette: Comment on this View and the pins toggle are icon-only Segments in the same pill and the toggle swaps two Segments, because a Segment has no icon state. The tooltips are Stack cards above the pill, one per reason, because the Adapter has no Tooltip.
A blocked Segment keeps its key hint here; the real pill drops the hint of a tool that cannot be used at all (a person without the permission key, a phone).
Every visible string is bound with $i18n except identities (key caps and the permission key); en-US and zh-TW keep identical key sets.
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A View is open on the canvas with a rendered frame. The pill is not drawn while the frame is not (no View, an invalid Adapter set or an invalid Variant), and the Prototype player replaces it with its own dock.

The base state is the Select tool in effect on a live session; Variants show the other tools, the tooltips, a pill whose tools are unavailable while the Preview session is not live, a Comment tool the person may not use, and the pins hidden.
The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; on a compact canvas the tool labels give way to their icons.
spec.intent: Show the floating tool pill at the bottom of the canvas: the three canvas tools, Comment on this View and the pins toggle, and how a tool that is unavailable stays in the pill, dimmed, with the reason one hover away.
interactionRules: Exactly one of Select, Comment and Interact is in effect; the Comment tool takes the annotation tone and the others the primary one, and an in-effect Comment tool stays pressable so it can be turned off.

While the Preview session is connecting, reconnecting or stopped every tool and Comment on this View are unavailable and the tooltip says why; nothing disappears and nothing silently does nothing, and using one anyway says the reason aloud.

A person who may not start comments (a missing permission key, a phone, a Workspace schema this UIUX does not support) still sees the Comment tool and Comment on this View, dimmed, with that reason; the other tools keep working and show no key hint for the tool that cannot be used at all.
The pins toggle shows Hide pins while pins are drawn and Show pins while they are hidden, with its shortcut Shift C in the tooltip; hiding pins never hides the Comments list.
